title: Get a permit for an advertising sign in a public place
what: Get the council's permit before putting an advertising sign or bill on a road, footpath, council property or other public place.

laws.title: Shire of Chittering Local Government Property and Public Places Local Law 2023

sources.title: Shire of Chittering Local Government Property and Public Places Local Law 2023
sources.locator: cl 8.2(2), as made, Gazette No. 66, 6 Jun 2023
sources.quote: A person must not erect or display a public interest sign on or in any local government property or a public place unless that person has a permit issued by the local government for that purpose.

The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found.
